01

“or a trace of knowledge”

Two explanations transmitted from Ata ibn Yasar and Abu Salama (Q 46:4).

891
Explanation from Ata ibn Yasar No. 891: 1

Ata ibn Yasar

English
Transmission wording
891: 1. Sufyan, from Safwan ibn Sulaym, from Ata ibn Yasar, who said:
There was a prophet among the prophets who used to draw lines, and whoever's lines matched his, he knew [the matter], so that was knowledge (verse 4).
العربية
891: 1 سفيان عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ كَانَ نَبِيٌّ مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ يَخُطُّ فَمَنْ وَافَقَ مِثْلَ خَطِّهِ عَلِمَهُ فَهُوَ علم (الآية 4) .
Edition record 371515 · p. 276Link to report ↗
892
Explanation from Abu Salama No. 892: 2

Abu Salama

English
Transmission wording
892: 2. Sufyan, from Safwan ibn Sulaym, from Abu Salama, on His words
"or a trace of knowledge": He said, line-drawing (verse 4).
العربية
892: 2 سفيان عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ فِي قَوْلِهِ أَوْ أثارة من علم قال الخط (الآية 4) .

02

“Indeed, those who say, 'Our Lord is God,' and then remain…”

An explanation transmitted from Nimran al-Bajali (Q 46:13).

893
Explanation from Nimran al-Bajali No. 893: 3

Nimran al-Bajali

English
Transmission wording
893: 3. Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Amir ibn Sad, from Nimran al-Bajali,
"report__pb">⦗p. 277⦘ who said: I recited this verse to Abu Bakr al-Siddiq: "Indeed, those who say, 'Our Lord is God,' and then remain upright": He said, they are those who did not associate anything with God (verse 13).
العربية
الإسناد
893: 3 سفيان عن أبي اسحق عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ نِمَرانَ الْبَجَلِيِّ
"report__pb">⦗p. 277⦘ قَالَ قَرَأْتُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا قَالَ هُمُ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُشْرِكُوا بالله شيئا (الآية 13) .

03

“And mention the brother of Ad, when he warned his people at al-Ahqaf”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 46:21).

894
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 894: 4

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
894: 4. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid:
"And mention the brother of Ad, when he warned his people at al-Ahqaf": He said, al-Ahqaf is a land (verse 21).
العربية
894: 4 سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ وَاذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنْذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بالأحقاف قال الاحقاف ارض (الآية 21) .
Edition record 371516 · p. 277Link to report ↗
04

“This is a cloud bringing us rain”

An explanation transmitted from Amr ibn Maymun (Q 46:24, 46:25).

895
Explanation from Amr ibn Maymun No. 895: 5

Amr ibn Maymun

English
Transmission wording
895: 5. Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Amr ibn Maymun, who said:
When the people of Ad saw the cloud, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain." God said, "Rather, it is what you sought to hasten: a wind in which is a painful punishment, destroying everything by the command of its Lord." The wind would lift the shepherd and his sheep between the sky and the earth and then overturn it upon them (verses 24, 25).
العربية
895: 5 سفيان عن أبي اسحق عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ قَالَ لَمَّا رَأَى قَوْمُ عَادٍ الْعَارِضَ قالوا هذا عارض ممطرنا قَالَ اللَّهُ بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُمْ بِهِ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أليم تدمر كل شئ يأمر ربها فَإِنْ كَانَتِ الرِّيحُ لَتَدْفَعُ الرَّاعِي وَغَنَمَهُ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ تقلبها عليهم (الآية 24 و 25) .
